title: New Year's in NYC with kids
hook: New Year's in NYC with kids, minus Times Square
who: Families with kids about 3 to 15 (notes for strollers and teens)

days.title: Skates, a show and the tree

stops.name: Bryant Park Winter Village rink
stops.why: Free-admission skating; skate aids free before 10:30 AM
stops.kid_note: Penguin aids for beginners under 4 feet; kids under 14 skate with an adult.
stops.booking_note: Reserve an entry time on bryantpark.org; rental skates cost extra. Open daily, weather permitting.

stops.name: Ellen's Stardust Diner
stops.why: The waitstaff sings from open to close, 7 AM to midnight
stops.kid_note: Stroller parking out front on Broadway, with free locks (space is limited).

stops.name: Radio City Christmas Spectacular
stops.why: The Rockettes' 2026 run goes through Jan 4, 2027
stops.kid_note: For little ones, pick the earliest show of the day.
stops.booking_note: Book on rockettes.com/christmas; we didn't check Dec 30 show times.

stops.name: Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree
stops.why: Lit on Dec 2, with the rink below it (open since Oct 10)
stops.booking_note: 2026 visiting hours hadn't been announced when we checked.

stops.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
stops.why: Open 10 AM to 5 PM: the only Met day on this trip

stops.name: Junior's Restaurant & Bakery
stops.why: Early dinner and cheesecake in Downtown Brooklyn
stops.booking_note: Thursdays 7 AM to 11 PM; reserve or join the waitlist online.

stops.name: Prospect Park fireworks, Grand Army Plaza
stops.why: Free New Year's Eve fireworks, 10 PM to 12:30 AM
stops.kid_note: Little ones asleep by then? The Times Square webcast starts at 6 PM; watch the ball drop from bed.
stops.booking_note: Free; reserve a spot through prospectpark.org/nye.

legs.note: Rest in the afternoon. Stay clear of the Times Square viewing areas, which open at 3 PM.
Kids under 44 inches ride free (up to three per paying adult).
Plan the trip with the MTA app before you go.

stops.name: Statue of Liberty
stops.why: Open Jan 1; it closes only on Thanksgiving and Dec 25
stops.kid_note: Last entry into the statue is 3:30 PM.
stops.booking_note: Ferry only, with Statue City Cruises from Battery Park.

legs.note: Ferries leave from Battery Park in Lower Manhattan.
The only way onto the island.

stays.name: The Plaza
stays.why: Fifth Avenue at Central Park South, and Eloise's hotel; the splurge.

stays.name: Hotel Beacon
stays.why: Upper West Side rooms and suites with kitchenettes and a guest laundry.

stays.name: Pod Times Square
stays.why: Bunk pods with twin beds, a few blocks west of Times Square. Book two for a family of four.

heads_ups.text: Times Square at midnight isn't a kid plan: viewing areas open at 3 PM, there are no portable restrooms, and if you leave your spot you can't get back in.
The Met is closed on Wednesdays and on New Year's Day, so on a Dec 30 to Jan 1 trip, Thursday Dec 31 is your only Met day.
Bryant Park's free skating still needs a reserved entry time; bring-your-own-skates slots open a week out, and skate aids are free before 10:30 AM.
Prospect Park's free fireworks need an RSVP; the Statue of Liberty is open on Jan 1 (it closes only on Thanksgiving and Dec 25).
Kids under 44 inches ride the subway free, up to three per paying adult.

Time Out New York (Sep 29, 2026): tree lighting Wed Dec 2; The Rink at Rockefeller Center opens Oct 10; visiting hours to be announced
